finding: 异常检测（YOLOX 检测 + HF²-VAD）在 7 段含异常事件的测试视频上取得 AUROC 92.1%
statistic: an area under the curve of 92.1%
quote: To evaluate the proposed abnormal behaviour detection model, it is tested on 7 videos which result in an area under the curve of 92.1%.
supports_claim: 自监督视频异常检测能有效筛选含异常行为的帧

finding: Byte³Track 跟踪性能：2.5 分钟视频平均 MOTA 87.7%、MOTP 80.4%、IDF1 90.8%、HOTA 72.0%；5 分钟视频 MOTA 85.4%、MOTP 82.6%、IDF1 89.1%、HOTA 72.5%
quote: obtaining 87.7% MOTA, 80.4% MOTP, 90.8% IDF1 and 72.0% HOTA scores on average for the 2.5-minute videos, and 85.4% MOTA, 82.6% MOTP, 89.1% IDF1 and 72.5% HOTA scores for the 5-minute video, respectively.
supports_claim: 改进后的跟踪器在自建火鸡数据上达到所述跟踪精度

finding: 与原版 ByteTrack 相比（2.5 分钟视频平均）：MOTA +8.2、MOTP +0.3、IDF1 +2.7、HOTA +2.2 个百分点，身份切换数 N_ID 减少 166
quote: Compared to ByteTrack, the proposed tracker improved MOTA by 8.2%,MOTP by 0.3%,IDF1 by 2.7%,HOTA by 2.2%,and reduced \( {\mathrm{N}}_{\mathrm{ID}} \) by 166 in the 2.5-minute videos on the average.
supports_claim: 第三步关联使跟踪指标整体优于原版 ByteTrack

quote: modIoU score outperforms the original ByteTrack implementation and the proposed implementation based on IoU in contrast to modIoU in MOTA, MOTP, IDF1, and HOTA scores.
supports_claim: 第三步关联与 modIoU 分别有正贡献

finding: modIoU 版并非全指标占优：2.5 分钟消融中其 N_ID=169，高于 IoU 版的 140（表 3）——modIoU 以更多身份切换换取整体跟踪性能
quote: Nevertheless, although to use of IoU leads to fewer identity switches, it underperforms in tracking.
supports_claim: “modIoU 全面更优”不成立，N_ID 指标上 IoU 变体更好

finding: 5 分钟视频基准（表 6）：Byte³Track 五项指标全部最佳（MOTA 85.431、MOTP 82.563、IDF1 89.128、HOTA 72.523、N_ID 78）
quote: As shown in Table 6,the Byte \( {}^3 \) Track algorithm obtains the best results on all evaluation metrics when tested on the 5-minute video.
supports_claim: Byte³Track 在较长视频上保持最优跟踪性能

finding: 遮挡个例（图 5）：火鸡身体大部被遮挡时，靠仍可见的头部在第 846 帧被重识别，ByteTrack 则赋予新 ID
quote: It was able to reidentify the turkey, since its head remained visible during the occlusion event.
supports_claim: 基于头部的第三步关联可缓解遮挡造成的目标丢失

finding: 检测数据集规模：人工标注 1,808 帧、共 35,489 只火鸡；头部区域标注由颜色范围与闭运算自动生成
quote: First, a turkey detection dataset is created by manually annotating 1,808 frames containing 35,489 turkeys.
supports_claim: 本研究自建数据的规模与构成

finding: 异常检测数据：训练集 8 段视频（每段 300 帧、30 fps、仅正常行为、无标注）；测试集 7 段、共 2,167 帧、带帧级标注
statistic: 300 frames with a frame rate of 30 frames/second
quote: The applied datasets for training and evaluating the anomaly detection model contain 8 training videos and 7 testing videos.
supports_claim: 异常检测的训练/测试协议构成

finding: 作者自述局限：头部区域采用自动标注，其边界框可能不如人工标注准确；作者预期人工标注训练可带来更好性能
quote: Most likely, this may have resulted in less accurate bounding boxes than when using manual annotation.
supports_claim: 头部自动标注的精度上限是结果的一个约束
limitations: 头部区域自动标注的边界框可能不如人工标注准确（作者自述）

finding: 作者自述局限：系统只检测异常行为、不将其分类到具体行为类别，分类留作未来工作
quote: detects abnormal behaviour only and does not classify this into specific behavioural classes.
supports_claim: 本文方法的输出边界是异常帧筛选而非行为分类
limitations: 只检测异常行为、不分类具体行为类别（作者自述）

finding: 数据可用性：作者声明没有共享数据的许可，三套自建数据集未公开
quote: The authors do not have permission to share data.
supports_claim: 本文结果无法用公开数据独立复现

finding: 跟踪阈值经附录 A 逐参数扫描选定且两套时长取值不同：2.5 分钟视频 θ_modIoU=0.99、θ_high=0.7、θ_low=0.68；5 分钟视频 θ_modIoU=0.95、θ_high=0.4、θ_low=0.3
quote: Based on the results in Table A.2,we have chosen for \( {\theta }_{\text{ high }} = {0.7} \) .
supports_claim: 报告性能依赖按视频时长调定的阈值

finding: 训练配置：HF²-VAD 沿用 Ped2 参数（batch size 128、80 epochs、w_r=1.0、w_p=0.1、k=4）；YOLOX 训练 400 epochs、batch 16；硬件为 RTX5000（16 GB）服务器
statistic: the batch size is 128 , the number of epochs is 80
quote: Moreover,we set \( k = 4 \) ,meaning that the four preceding frames are employed to predict the next frame during training and testing.
supports_claim: 复现所需的关键实现条件
